entries.en: I met up with Takemi[n]at the aquarium...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You know, some studies suggested[n]aquariums are good for relieving[n]anxiety.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Now that I'm actually in one, I think[n]I get what they're saying.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...You know what I mean. I'm having a[n]nice time. And having my little guinea[n]pig here definitely doesn't hurt.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Never would have guessed I'd be going[n]on aquarium dates at my age.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Kind of nice, though.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I get that feeling a lot with you. Pretty[n]hard to get used to.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Thank you, by the way. For... returning[n]the favor, in your own way.
We're just getting started.
This date's far from over.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Oh yeah? I'm looking forward to it.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Let's see if you can surprise me.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...So here's another stupid question.[n]Is this a date for White Day?
Of course.
That's right.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I see. Thanks for indulging me.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Valentine's Day came and went, so I[n]wasn't sure if we were doing anything...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It's nice to know you were thinking[n]about me.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: So. How long are we gonna dance[n]around this? Is this meant to be an[n]apology?
Of course.
Yes.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Well, since my guinea pig's being[n]sincere for once... I accept.
...Takemi seems pleased.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I think I've seen enough fish for one[n]day. So what now?
I have a reservation set.
I have a place in mind.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Oh really.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Then let's see this place.
